title: Eric Schmidt says coding is changing forever as AI takes over the heavy lifting
key_facts: Schmidt spoke on Blackstone's Inside Blackstone podcast.
He said AI tools can produce code beyond what he could write at 22.
He compared old programming to building a house brick by brick.
He still thinks young people should learn programming; developers will act as architects.
The article adds that McKinsey notes AI is absorbing entry-level work that built junior judgement.
quote_evidence: Speaking on Blackstone's Inside Blackstone podcast, Schmidt reflected on his own experience as a programmer and said, "My field is over."
Schmidt's message, therefore, is less about the death of coding than its transformation.
why_it_matters_hint: A tech veteran says AI is shifting programmers from writing code to directing it.
notes: Podcast date not given; Moneycontrol first published 6 Oct 2026. The article adds context from IEEE Software and McKinsey, which is not Schmidt's.
